summary: Alias-resolved serving model IDs are recorded, not rejected. Anthropic: a message_start model that differs from the requested alias (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6 -> claude-sonnet-4-6-20260101) is accepted; Completion.model/ResponseCreated carry the served ID and native_history now always records both model (served) and requested_model, and signed-history replay matches on requested_model (falling back to model for older records), as DeepSeek already did. Gemini: the modelVersion equality/dated-suffix check is removed; the served version stays in the gemini_finish annotation while history remains keyed by the requested model. Legacy credential headers (no explicit connection) now follow the wire: AnthropicMessages sends x-api-key (plus the existing anthropic-version: 2023-06-01) instead of Authorization: Bearer, for both plain api_key and secret handles; Gemini keeps x-goog-api-key and Chat/Responses keep Bearer.
